content.title: S90F vs. S90D | OLED TV Comparison | Samsung Canada
content.text: It’s been another exciting year of innovation for Samsung TVs. This guide goes through many features that make the S90F a significant upgrade from the S90D TVs. Starting with the advanced AI-powered 4K 3rd generation processor, our most advanced NPU (Neural Processing Unit) runs twice as fast as the S90D TV. It has 6.4 times greater AI neural networks (128), 2.1x faster GPU, and a 17% faster CPU. It’s light years ahead in many ways. What are the differences between the S90F and S90D OLED TV? Now, let’s delve into the key differences and features, highlighting what makes the S90F TV series a step forward. 2025 Samsung OLED TV models release date The new 2025 Samsung TV models, including the S95F, S90F, and S85F will be available for purchase on April 16, 2025. Explore the specifications of our latest 2025 models below. Whether you stream, watch live sports, or mainly play video games, discover the Samsung TV that’s perfect for you. If you’re a sports fan, enjoy playing fast-paced video games, or simply want more depth in your movies go for the S90F with our latest Gen3 processor, 128 AI neural networks with 4k upscaling. If it comes down to price, and you still want a great TV, then the S90D is for you. Either way, you’ll be impressed with the current state of Samsung TVs. 1.
